entities.text:
\LNOTES:
1.	SCOPE: THIS DETAIL ADDRESSES ARRANGEMENT OF SLAB REBAR, ADD OR "TRIM" REBAR, AND ADD DIAGONAL REBAR AT OPENINGS IN CONCRETE SLABS AWAY FROM COLUMNS. THE DETAIL APPLIES FOR OPENINGS WITH ANY SHAPE. FOR PENETRATIONS CLOSE TO COLUMNS SEE "SLAB PENETRATIONS CLOSE TO COLUMNS" DETAILS
2.	FOR LOCATION OF OPENINGS SEE STRUCTURAL PLANS
3.	INSERTS/PENETRATIONS WITH A CLEAR DISTANCE WHICH IS LESS THAN THE DIAMETER OF THE LARGER OF THE TWO ARE CONSIDERED TO FORM A COMBINED OPENING
4.	IF THE COMBINED OPENING LENGTH IS LESS THAN 300mm AND NO SLAB REINFORCING IS INTERRUPTED, NO TRIM BARS ARE REQUIRED
5.	IF THE COMBINED OPENING LENGTH IS MORE THAN 300mm, BUT LESS THAN 600mm, PROVIDE 1-T16 T&B TRIM REBAR EA SIDE OF THE OPENING. NO DIAGONAL BARS ARE NECESSARY
6.	IF COMBINED OPENING LENGTH IS LARGER THAN 600mm REFER TO INSET DETAIL "B"

\LNOTES:
1.	THIS DETAIL ADDRESSES THE ARRANGEMENT OF CONDUITS WITHIN THE SLAB THICKNESS
2.	SLEEVES OR COMPRESSIBLE MATERIAL AROUND THE CONDUITS FOR MEP CODE COMPLIANCE SHALL BE SPECIFIED BY OTHERS. CONTRACTOR SHALL CONFIRM WITH MEP SUBCONTRACTORS OR MEP ENGINEER SUCH REQUIREMENT PRIOR TO PLACING THE CONDUITS WITHIN THE CONCRETE SLAB
3.	CONDUIT SHALL BE SUPPORTED BY ADDITIONAL REBAR AND CHAIRS IN THE SLAB
4.	CONDUIT SHALL STAY 2 FT CLEAR FROM COLUMN FACES, STUD RAILS, DROP PANELS, SHEAR WALLS.

NOTES:
1.	THIS DETAIL APPLIES AT LOCATIONS WHERE A DROP PANEL, OR THICKENED SLAB BAND, OR SLAB DOWNSTAND, AS SPECIFIED ON THE FLOOR PLANS, DERIVE SUPPORT ON AND EXTEND CONTINUOUSLY BETWEEN TWO CONSECUTIVE SUPPORTING MEMBERS, SUCH AS COLUMNS, WALLS, OR BEAMS. SEE INSET DETAIL "A".
2.	AT CONTINUOUS DROP PANELS AS DEFINED ABOVE, THE BOTTOM SLAB REBAR RUNNING PARALLEL TO THE CENTER LINE THRU THE TWO CONSECUTIVE SUPPORTING MEMBERS SHALL BE PLACED CLOSE TO THE BOTTOM FACE OF SUCH PANEL AS SHOWN ON INSET DETAILS "B" AND "C".
